semantics.sourceRefs: Repository-relative path, frozen Git blob identity and optional literal anchor/line at source.commit.
semantics.createdAt: Knowledge capture time; preserves original evidence timestamps; not a new test or provider verification time.
semantics.freshness: Compare every frozen project file plus new project files. Exclude knowledge/**, AGENTS.md and build/dependency directories; remote HEAD is not checked.
semantics.observations: Historical/local/browser records retain their own condition and revision scopes; source hash agreement is not independent verification of record truth.
